answer_1.quote: automatic MCQ generation has received extensive attention... generating MCQs from multimodal contexts... propose a novel framework named Chain-of-Exemplar (CoE), which combines retrieved exemplars and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning to generate educational questions and distractors from multimodal inputs of texts and images.

answer_2.quote: We first conduct evaluation on the question generation, including both automatic evaluation and human evaluation. Table presents the comparison of the automatic evaluation results... on both BLEU4 and ROUGE-L... Table 4 summarizes the automatic evaluation results for distractor generation... incorporate an additional metric to evaluate the question diversity automatically...

answer_4.quote: We further conduct human evaluation to evaluate the quality of the generated questions... we randomly select 50 question samples... employ three annotators with good English background to rate them... Moreover, we invited another three annotators to answer the selected 50 MCQs...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated on metrics including Readability, Appropriateness, Complexity, Engagement for questions and Overlap, Plausibility, Distinctiveness for distractors.
